metadata.title: Tribal Heart and Bone Cover Art

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, textured red heart pierced by a tan bone, set against a rough black square on a weathered parchment background with a geometric tribal border on the left edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Central heart and bone as the primary focal point
Rough black square framing the central icon
Parchment background providing a tactile, aged context
Geometric border anchoring the left vertical axis
coreInvariants: Rough, hand-painted edges on the black square
Primitive, slightly distressed rendering of the heart and bone
Geometric tribal pattern along the left margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The heart and bone are centered within a black square, which is itself centered on the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant red heart serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red heart, follows the diagonal line of the bone, then moves to the top display text and down to the bottom subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample parchment-colored negative space surrounds the central black square, creating a breathing room for the elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the black square and the parchment background; high saturation on the red heart against the muted tones.

letterConstructionRules: Internal decorative patterns (stripes/dots) within the glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature internal tribal-style hatching or geometric fills
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, decorative display type paired with a light, sketchy handwritten subtitle.
graphicDevices: Vertical geometric border on the left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the internal patterns and blocky structure of the display text.
Captures the feel of the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a weathered parchment background with a vertical tribal geometric border on the left. In the center, place a rough-edged black square containing a textured red heart pierced diagonally by a tan bone.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, blocky display text at the top with internal tribal patterns and wide tracking. Add a light, sketchy handwritten subtitle at the bottom with extra-wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the heart vibrant red and textured?
Is the black square's edge rough and hand-painted?
Does the parchment background look aged and stained?
Is the display text bold with internal patterns?
Is the left border geometric and tribal in style?

adjustableVariables: Roughness of the black square edges
Complexity of the tribal border pattern
Angle of the bone piercing the heart
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: High contrast between central icon and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the heart is the most saturated element.
Verify the parchment texture is visible throughout.
Check that the display text has internal decorative details.
Confirm the left border is strictly vertical and geometric.
recipe.reuseFormula: Primitive Icon + Rough Frame + Parchment Texture + Tribal Typography
